about: The Parkmed look as numbers. Counted from the Parkmed APEX starter stylesheet (apex-build skill, assets/starter/apex/static/__prefix__.css, recoloured to the Parkmed look on 12 Oct 2026) on 23 Nov 2026. The check and the starter both read from here: change a value here, not in the scripts.

spacing.notes: No single 4px base: the stylesheet writes even steps (gap 6 x15, 8 x20, 10 x12, 14 x9, 16 x7). Layout spacing uses the even steps. A control may also use 3, 5, 7, 9 or 11, as the button (7/12), field (7/10, label to box 5), small button (4/9) and note (11/14) classes do. The check counts a box as a control when it is at most two levels deep: it holds text, icons, or boxes that hold only those. A fix snaps to the nearest snapTo step, the smaller one on a tie.

radius.notes: 4 x11 and 6 x10 in the stylesheet; every larger radius there is a pill (half the height or more), which the check accepts.

fontSizes.notes: The type scale is 24 / 18 / 16 / 14 / 12; 13, 11 and 20 are the stylesheet's detail sizes. Body text is 14, labels and table headers 12, the page title 24 (weight 600).

colors.notes: Green #55ae65 is for the wordmark only. Amber (warn) means due soon or below target; red (bad) only critical. A normal state has no colour. Teal is never used.
